hypothesis: A candidate number's count of appearances in the three immediately preceding main draws (0, 1, 2, or 3) may provide cutoff-safe conditional information about inclusion in the next main draw. One fixed four-state estimator may improve a deterministic three-line disjoint union18 portfolio over the exact geometry-matched null.
research_question: Does one frozen three-draw candidate-membership-count estimator improve a three-line disjoint union18 portfolio on targets 401..1250 under the unchanged four-metric strict gate?
novelty_statement: One candidate-specific four-state count feature using exactly the three immediately preceding main draws. It differs from E053's two-draw bit pattern and E069's one-draw membership indicator. One fixed Beta-smoothed estimator, one deterministic portfolio, one historical walk-forward, and one geometry-matched random comparator; no variants or parameter search.

feature_definition.source: The three immediately preceding draws' six main numbers only; bonus numbers are excluded.

state_encoding.0: candidate absent from all three immediately preceding main draws
state_encoding.1: candidate present in exactly one of the three immediately preceding main draws
state_encoding.2: candidate present in exactly two of the three immediately preceding main draws
state_encoding.3: candidate present in all three immediately preceding main draws

feature_definition.candidate_universe: All integers 1..45 are scored for every target.
feature_definition.transition_history: For each historical outcome round u=4..t-1, classify every candidate by its count of appearances in draws u-3, u-2, and u-1, then observe inclusion in draw u.

source_data_hash_scope_note: Raw canonical lotto_data.csv bytes; exactly 1,250 non-empty contiguous draw records. The full file is frozen at round 1250; no later outcome is read.
training_cutoff_rule: For target t, use only draws 1..t-1. Historical transition outcomes u=4..t-1 use draws u-3, u-2, and u-1 as the three-draw membership-count state and draw u as the outcome. Score target t from draws t-3, t-2, and t-1, then add target t only after scoring.

estimator.prior_mean: 6/45 main-number inclusion probability under the uniform 6-of-45 null
estimator.state_definition: Count 0..3 of candidate appearances in the three immediately preceding main draws.

portfolio.geometry: Exactly three pairwise-disjoint six-number lines, union18.
portfolio.selection: Three sequential calls to the unchanged E045 choose_disjoint_ticket selector, passing the E073 score as both role_score and global_score; remove selected numbers after each line.
portfolio.line_order: Line 1, then line 2, then line 3, each selected from the remaining unused numbers.

random_comparator.method: For each target, uniformly permute labels 1..45 jointly over the three fixed model lines, preserving three six-number lines, pairwise disjointness, union18, and line-incidence geometry.

inference.ci_method: Two-sided percentile moving-block bootstrap of per-target differences from the exact geometry-matched union18 null.
